verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI gateway, since products of this kind can ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. Every evidence item describes a Cloudflare-hosted, dashboard-managed service (Cloudflare cache, Cloudflare billing). Nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment, an open-source release, or a downloadable image of the core gateway.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
